title: campanula lavrensis var. breueri
intro: Campanula lavrensis var. breueri, commonly known as Bluebell of Norway or Norwegian harebell, is a plant species within the Campanula genus. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Campanula lavrensis var. breueri include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
